dialogues.speaker: Cat's Tail Message Board
dialogues.text: If you have anything to share, be it brooding or joyous, distressing or hilarious, write them down on our Message Board! Cat's Tail is all cat ears!

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Hey, you! Yeah, you, the one reading this message."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Add 'just like love' at the end of any sentence, and it will sound wise."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Hard work is all there is to the craft! Just like love!"

dialogues.speaker: Cat's Tail's reply
dialogues.text: Cat's Tail is always here for you, no matter when! Just like love!
